sentinel_reproduction: a fresh engine lists only real Git projects
GET /path?directory=<a NON-Git directory> resolves its worktree to "/"
that registers a project under the id "global" with worktree "/"
GET /project then includes {"id":"global","worktree":"/"} and keeps it
observations: the global/root entry is created on demand, not shipped with a fresh engine
any client that has ever opened a non-Git directory will see it, so discovery must always filter
reject it on both the global id and the filesystem-root worktree
Project.name is optional; fall back to the worktree basename, never the raw path
